sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers SP-700 only for Plastiche Fenestrelle (SUP-F). It has no entry for Minuterie Germanasca (SUP-G) for SP-700 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR. SUP-G's audit qualifies the company only and does not approve it for any part.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source

findings.why: SP-700 belongs to PRG-Z, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for a change of source, and 90 days' notice of the change. No approval or notification is in the documents.

The drawing requires PA66-GF30 (MAT-PA66GF30). SUP-G is qualified only for DC04, C67S and 42CrMo4 steels, and its commodity is steel stampings, clips and pins. It has no qualified capability for PA66-GF30 or injection moulding.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-G has 3.1 certificates only for DC04, C67S and 42CrMo4. There is none for MAT-PA66GF30. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must answer this open question.
